product.name: my quant
product.description: A finite market briefing for web, iOS, and Android with plain-English stories and evidence boundaries.

features.title: Finite daily edition
features.description: Selects up to five stories with one representative per enabled topic before ranked fill.

features.title: Validated correction-aware feed
features.description: Only a fully valid versioned feed can replace the last accepted edition.

features.title: Offline reading
features.description: Falls back to the last valid cache and keeps saved story snapshots on-device.

features.title: Topic controls
features.description: Lets readers tune the finite edition without creating an account or uploading a portfolio.

session_compatibility.mcp: Legacy Mcp-Session-Id values are accepted without rotation; the public MCP surface is stateless.
session_compatibility.product: Existing AsyncStorage feed caches, topic settings, and saved-story snapshots are not read, migrated, or invalidated by these endpoints.

boundaries: No accounts, brokerage links, portfolio import, advertising SDK, or social graph.
Reader settings and saved stories remain on the device.
The app presents sourced editorial analysis, not personalized investment advice.

cases.prompt: What topic controls does MyQuant document, and which actions would still require me to use the app?
cases.expected_behavior: Describe documented controls and distinguish feature discovery from reading or changing preferences.
